messages:
liam: Quick idea capture from design sync: propose 'fencewalk' refactor to separate latency-critical routing from enrichment + make cache ownership explicit. High level plan below.

anya: Nice name. What's the rollout surface?

liam: Phases: (1) mirror-only routing shim (telemetry only); (2) per-tenant opt-in read routing at 5%; (3) dual-write session metadata + reconciliation; (4) widen to non-SLA tenants; (5) deprecate old proxy. Each phase gated with SLOs.

meera: Migration blockers: key-prefix collisions, ordering, TTL mismatch. We'll create a reconciliation job and a prefix-version marker. I can own that.

sam: Implementation note: keep the shim tiny. It only handles header-based affinity and tenant routing. No enrichment logic until phase 3. We'll expose X-Fencewalk-Session for sticky routing.

mikel: Ops: need per-tenant rollback and a canary pop. Auto-rollback thresholds: p99 > baseline+25% or error-rate >0.5% sustained 5m. Also divergence rollback if reconciliation finds >0.05% mismatched keys in 1h. I'll draft runbook.

liam: Feature flag example for rollout service:

{"flags": {"fencewalk.enabled": false, "fencewalk.canary_tenants": ["alpha-co"], "fencewalk.pop_allowlist": ["eu-west-1"]}}

anya: Metrics to gate on: p50/p95/p99 latency, KV miss ratio, enrichment lag, per-tenant cost delta. Tag traces with "fencewalk.phase" and "fencewalk.owner".

meera: KV topology decision: per-pop shard with tenant prefixes to keep hotpath low-latency. Migration plan: writes to new shard during dual-write, reads stick to old until reconciliation passes, then swap reads. Conflict policy: tombstone-aware last-writer-wins; surface anomalies.

sam: Tests: replay a short window of real traces against the shim in replay mode to catch ordering regressions before phase 3.

mikel: I'll provision a canary cluster and add synthetic load profiles to detect batching and cost regressions. deploy-bot: queue canary when ready.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pipeline created: fencewalk/canary/1769004321. CI: https://ci.internal/fencewalk/canary/1769004321

liam: Action items: Sam - mirror shim PR; Meera - prefix marker + reconciliation job; Anya - canary dashboard gating; Mikel - runbook + alerts. Keep initial surface minimal: only routing and affinity in phases 1/2.

anya: Sounds good. We'll review owners and sprint estimates in next arch sync.
